subject: Life Skills
title: Taxi and Rideshare Verification
description: Learn Taxi and Rideshare Verification in one minute.

hook.text: She got into a car she assumed was her Uber. The driver did not match the app. It was a stranger's car.

buildup.text: Fake rideshare pickups are a growing threat. Criminals pull up and say your name to get you inside quickly.

discovery.text: Never confirm your name. Ask the driver 'Who are you picking up?' If they cannot say your name, do not get in.

twist.text: Match the license plate, car model, and driver photo before opening the door. All three. One match is not enough.

climax.text: Share your trip with a friend using the app's share feature. Someone should always know where you are heading.

punchline.text: They say your name? Not enough. They must prove it.

quiz.question: What should you ask a rideshare driver before getting in?
